name: fix-embedded-assets-realiser
body: source: the stale spine edge domain.entity.theme —realised-by→ solution.component.embedded-assets; inconsistency: the theme entity realised the embedded-assets component, but that mapping was correct only while the built-in EY theme, fonts and logos were embedded in the binary. global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets (with requirements.requirement.embedded-assets) removed all embedded presentation media and EY branding, so no theme artefact is embedded any more. The embedded core that remains — the vendored reveal.js runtime and the unbranded deck/error/gallery page shells — is not a theme asset and is a serving concern: domain.service.serve-deck's own body already covers "embedded assets" alongside HTTP serving, deck assets/ and the /templates gallery. resolution: removed domain.entity.theme → solution.component.embedded-assets and re-pointed the component at domain.service.serve-deck. domain.entity.theme is now realised only by solution.component.theme-registry (the run-time theme library reader, which is correct); solution.component.embedded-assets remains realised by domain.service.serve-deck. No implemented-by edges changed. [autonomous]
